news.og_desc: Kathmandu. Pakistan's Ambassador to Nepal, Mohammad Amir Khan, hosted a dinner for Misbah-ul-Haq, former Pakistan captain and head coach of Sudurpaschim Royals in the third edition of Nepal Premier League (NPL) cricket. Ambassador Khan organized the dinner in honor of Misbah on Sunday evening in Kathmandu. On the occasion, cricket was discussed as a medium to further strengthen mutual relations and friendship between Nepal and Pakistan. Misbah, considered one of Pakistan's successful former captains, led the national team to significant success in his playing career. As captain, he led Pakistan to win the Asia Cup title in 2012.
